# @mastra/ring-signals

## 0.1.1

### Patch Changes

- Stopped publishing JavaScript source maps (`.js.map` and `.cjs.map` files) and their `//# sourceMappingURL=` comments. They made up more than half of the installed size of some packages and pointed at `src/*.ts` files that are not included in the package. ([#31176](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/31176))

- Stopped publishing TypeScript declaration map files (`.d.ts.map`). They pointed at source files that are not included in the package, so they could not be used after install. Installs are smaller (about 1,050 fewer files and 2 MB less for `@mastra/core`), and go to definition and type checking work exactly as before. ([#31173](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/31173))

- Updated dependencies [[`8bc3a19`](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/commit/8bc3a19a73e6e683a29d8c8cf8ab1f0bf4343a26), ## 0.1.1-alpha.0

### Patch Changes

- Stopped publishing JavaScript source maps (`.js.map` and `.cjs.map` files) and their `//# sourceMappingURL=` comments. They made up more than half of the installed size of some packages and pointed at `src/*.ts` files that are not included in the package. ([#31176](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/31176))

- Stopped publishing TypeScript declaration map files (`.d.ts.map`). They pointed at source files that are not included in the package, so they could not be used after install. Installs are smaller (about 1,050 fewer files and 2 MB less for `@mastra/core`), and go to definition and type checking work exactly as before. ([#31173](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/31173))

## 0.1.0

### Minor Changes

- Added `@mastra/ring-signals` for connecting Ring doorbells and cameras to Mastra agents. Ring events such as doorbell presses and motion arrive in agent threads as notification signals, and the agent can fetch a snapshot or video clip for an event with the `ring_snapshot` and `ring_clip` tools. ([#28864](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/28864))

  ```ts
  import { Agent } from '@mastra/core/agent';
  import { RingSignals } from '@mastra/ring-signals';

  export const homeAgent = new Agent({
    id: 'home-agent',
    name: 'Home Agent',
    instructions: 'Say briefly whether each doorbell event needs attention.',
    model: 'openai/gpt-6.1-sol',
    signals: [
      new RingSignals({
        events: {
          device_offline: { priority: 'low', summary: 'Device went offline.', coalesce: true },
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
  ```

  Mastra adds the routes Ring calls for account linking and webhooks to the server. See the [Ring integration guide](https://mastra.ai/integrations/channels/ring).

## 0.1.0-alpha.0

### Minor Changes

- Added `@mastra/ring-signals` for connecting Ring doorbells and cameras to Mastra agents. Ring events such as doorbell presses and motion arrive in agent threads as notification signals, and the agent can fetch a snapshot or video clip for an event with the `ring_snapshot` and `ring_clip` tools. ([#28864](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/28864))

  ```ts
  import { Agent } from '@mastra/core/agent';
  import { RingSignals } from '@mastra/ring-signals';

  export const homeAgent = new Agent({
    id: 'home-agent',
    name: 'Home Agent',
    instructions: 'Say briefly whether each doorbell event needs attention.',
    model: 'openai/gpt-6.1-sol',
    signals: [
      new RingSignals({
        events: {
          device_offline: { priority: 'low', summary: 'Device went offline.', coalesce: true },
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
  ```

  Mastra adds the routes Ring calls for account linking and webhooks to the server. See the [Ring integration guide](https://mastra.ai/integrations/channels/ring).
